author: PokerFace
body:
Hi, so for the first time in forever, there's been quite a bit of discussion in the Media channel on the Avicus Slack. We've been discussing a lot about making overlays for the livestreams. The team names and scores can be put up fine and dandy, but there is one problem.

The colors of the teams in TE maps vary. Most are Red vs. Blue, but there are other colors as well. On the overlay, we were planning on having each team represent one color for the match they play. It would be easier if the teams just sticked to one color so you wouldn't have to change the color on the overlay as well.

Ex: Cacalmarin vs. Xenarch
Maps: 
  • Plaza
  • Xena
  • Ambush
If Cacalmarin was assigned to the first team color, they would be red twice and green once. Why not make things simpler and make Xena a Red vs. Blue as well? Otherwise, we would have to create a completely new overlay just so the team colors represent the map.

This would require a few minutes to fix the YML and the map's block elements, but it will create better organization in the long run.

Opinions/Suggestions are appreciated.

title: [SUG] Red vs. Blue for TM

replies.author: hasl
replies.body: Red vs Blue is regarded as the 'default' team colours in the map-making community, but maps like Xena spice that up and I really enjoy playing against Yellow/Green. I can understand from a realistic media it's more practical to use the same colours for every tournament map, but if it benefits in the long run then yes.
